purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: City-specific Jincheng registry presence is directly confirmed by the official municipal registration-center portal. Its cadastral-map query guide is an image-based instructions page; no account, address, unit number, title number, search, or map selection was used. No public geometry-only service schema or safe allowlist was verified.
registryAssessment: The official Jincheng Real Estate Registration and Transaction Center identifies itself as a municipal registration institution under the Jincheng Planning and Natural Resources Bureau; the official city government portal confirms the municipal jurisdiction. Queue coordinates at 35.5000 N, 112.8480 E place this at 晋城, Shanxi. The center provides registration services but does not establish public parcel-vector access.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Jincheng Real Estate Registration and Transaction Center site says the center was formed by combining municipal real-estate transaction and land-registration offices and is subordinate to the city planning/natural-resources bureau.
Official center page publishes a cadastral-map query guide. The page is an instructions/article page; no property was searched or selected.
Official Jincheng municipal government portal corroborates the target jurisdiction; the point corresponds to Jincheng, Shanxi.
Official center describes registration/change/mortgage workflows for existing rights holders and required documents; no transaction or record was accessed.
